text: You're by the East River, going for a new stone-skipping record.
Your best is four. This one feels like five.
All the water on Earth just vanished. All except the water inside living things.
For a heartbeat, the fish just hang there.
Then everything in the river drops twelve metres.
Your record throw lands in a shopping cart.
Mittens has never liked the river more.
Clouds are water too. Every single one is gone.
New York Harbor is a valley of mud. Lady Liberty stands on a hill.
From space: no blue, no clouds, not even ice caps.
Then it all comes back at once.
The ferry bobs back up. Mittens gets soaked.
Your next stone skips five times. New record.
The strangest part? Out at sea, every ship just fell a hundred and twenty metres. Higher than the Statue of Liberty.
